author: Good Enough
description:
Patients were locked in restraint cages inside insane asylums, and left there for days.

In asylum history, these cages were used as “treatment,” where patients were confined in small enclosed spaces with little movement or contact, often worsening their mental and physical condition.

This video explores one of the most disturbing medical practices in history and what patients were forced to endure.
